title: Rivers Edge
summary: A modern farmhouse on the Vaal River’s “Millionaire’s Bend” — twelve bedrooms, eleven of them turned to the water, around double-volume entertaining spaces.
story: Nestled near the serene Vaal River, this expansive home is a true entertainer's paradise, boasting immaculate panoramic views. Designed by the talented @nicki_de_souza from Footprint Architects, this masterpiece seamlessly merges luxury with nature. De Souza's exceptional design ethos and dedication to client vision make this home a standout example of modern architecture tailored for effortless living and entertaining.

@nicki_de_souza and his team at Footprint Architects are renowned for their client-focused approach, ensuring each project receives the utmost attention to detail from inception to completion. Their innovative use of space and form results in homes that are both beautiful and functional, creating harmonious living environments that perfectly blend with their surroundings.

Welcome to this Scenic Modern Farmhouse Mansion located on the Vaal River, Gauteng. This timeless South African Home has breathtaking views to the water. The Homes light, bright and luxurious interior design was built to entertain large numbers of people, with 11 of the 12 bedrooms opening up to the views of this property. The stand out feature of the home is an open plan entertainment area with double volume spaces, bringing in tons of natural light. This home is a true example of sustainable building, blending in with the landscape its located in. From the understated exterior to the truly luxurious interior, welcome to Rivers Edge!
Location: Vanderbijlpark, South West of Johannesburg, South Africa. The area is also known to the locals as billionaires bend.

video.title: Inside a Modern Farmhouse Mansion With Views of The Vaal River | Luxury House Tour

title: Sun Valley Manor
summary: A modern take on the South African farmhouse on the equestrian fields of Midrand, with interiors by Loredana Morton.
story: This week, we explore a stunning modern contemporary equestrian property. Renowned interior designer Loredana Morton Interiors has crafted a truly exceptional space.

Welcome to this Modern Luxurious Mansion and Estate, located on the Equestrian Fields of Midrand, Beaulieu, Johannesburg. This timeless South African Home has breathtaking Interiors Designed by Loredana Morton Interiors.

Sitting on a large plot of land, this modern take of a South African farmhouse has well Manicured Gardens with a long driveway leading you to a spectacular entrance. These gardens continue in the vast backyard, equipped with infinity edge pool, sunken firepit, basketball and tennis court, as well as a kiddies playground.

The main attraction, however, is the luxurious interior design. Whether it's the grand grand entrance with double staircase, a dream Kitchen with high end appliances, an executive dining room fit for architectural digest, an entertaining room and bar to host the biggest parties, or a primary Bedroom suite that will rival any, this home has it all!
Location: Midrand, Johannesburg, South Africa. The area is also known to the locals as Sun Valley.

video.title: Touring an Elegant Modern Mansion with Grand Interiors | Luxury House Tour

title: The Black Coffee Penthouse
summary: A two-storey penthouse atop Hallmark House, designed by Tristan du Plessis with Black Coffee and some of South Africa’s finest artists and designers.
story: Hallmark House features a range of curated shared spaces for guests and residents. It’s home to Johannesburgs premier jazz destination, the Marabi Jazz Club, where fine dining meets the captivating rhythms of Africa. Thorn, the trendy inner-city hub, combines a modern remote workspace and restaurant with a relaxed ambience. For grooming excellence, visit the exclusive Utters Unisex Barber, where vintage charm meets contemporary luxury. And don’t miss the Rooftop, the ultimate venue radiating glamour and style with breathtaking 360-degree views of the city.

And for the ultimate luxury experience, the penthouse suite at Hallmark House is a two-story marvel with sweeping panoramic views of Johannesburg. It’s the embodiment of the African dream and showcases the creativity flourishing in South Africa today.

The CBD is in the midst of an exciting urban renewal and cultural regeneration. This transformation is epitomised by Hallmark House. Hallmark House celebrates a unique mix of cultures, music, performance, art, and design, reflecting the city's rich history and vibrant present.

video.title: Inside DJ Black Coffees Award Winning Penthouse Apartment in Johannesburg | Luxury House Tour

title: Bush Outlook
summary: A linear, L-shaped “bushveld contemporary” house stretched along the green belt of Helderfontein Estate.
story: Welcome to this Bushveld Contemporary piece of architecture. We tour this linear L-Shaped luxury house nestled within Helderfontein Estates Green belt, stretching across the north facing frontage. The minimalist interior design includes neutral color’s and plenty of natural light, A true example of integrating the house to the surrounding natural environment.
Property Address: Helderfontein Estate, Fourways, Johannesburg, South Africa

video.title: A Nature Inspired Architectural Home in Helderfontein Estate | Luxury House Tour

title: Houghton Residence
summary: Top billing lifestyle! This Houghton residence was designed to combine indoor and outdoor living spaces seamlessly.

title: Seaside House, La Lucia
summary: A delicate seaside retreat on the water’s edge. Utilising sliding screen panels, the house can cocoon itself. Indoor-outdoor living includes garden courtyards and a protected garden.

title: Cantilever House, Fresnaye
summary: The double volume ground floor hosts the entertainment level. A spacious, open-plan fully imported, fitted kitchen with a scullery, pantry and separate laundry.
story: A dining room with a walk in wine cellar as well as two living areas, both with gas fireplaces. All of these generous spaces, lead out on to the expansive, outside entertainment area with a level garden, pool, water feature, bar, covered dining & lounge area and, the most incredible due north facing views.

Privacy is key with the en-suite master bedroom, dressing room, sauna, bath and steam-room situated across the entire top floor to enjoy the majestic views and sun setting over the ocean. A fully equipped gym can also be found on this level.

The other 4 grandiose bedrooms (of which 3 are en-suite) as well as a study are positioned on the second floor. All bedrooms offer a Smart-Home touchscreen system, allowing you to manage the shutters, air-conditioning, music and lighting. This floor also has a TV room.
With breathtaking, uninterrupted 360 degree views over the Atlantic Ocean, Robben Island and Lion’s Head, this house lends itself for grand scale entertainment.

title: Clifton Residences
summary: The design ingenuity and vision of global award-winning architects, SAOTA , has culminated in what must surely be Clifton's most elegant, luxurious, and private off-plan residential masterpiece.
story: The homes are designed primarily to capitalise on the world class ocean and mountain views at a very special site. Clifton, the Monte Carlo of Africa, provides easy access to the coastline's celebrated beaches, Table Mountain National Park, restaurants, shops, and nightlife, framed by unparalleled vistas of mountains and sea.

Meticulously finished, the penthouse and villa may be purchased in its entirety or as individual units. In both units; space, light and views offset natural stone, soft wood, marble and glass, in keeping with the world-famous location.

The open plan penthouse with its expansive deck and infinity pool offers an unparalleled luxury lifestyle while the villa with its private garden, unique water feature and pool, will appeal to a wide spectrum of buyers.
This is an exclusive investment offering the ultimate in understated elegance, exclusivity, luxury and privacy.

title: Cliff Villa, Knysna
summary: This magnificent Garden Route villa is positioned on Kenyans cliffs overlooking the Indian Ocean.

title: City Villa
summary: Crested on a steep site, ARRCC’s latest architectural design boasts striking city views. Designed as an iconic family home, with modern natural design direction, the villa is an interplay of rectangular forms, perpendicularly opposed with cantilevered concrete elements to create a powerful and sculptural composition. The organically shaped pool forms a sharp contrast against these rigid shapes, and shows off the magnificent views. A white, geometrically shaped screen installed on the exterior of the upper level, adds patterned textures to the exterior.
story: “The building sits comfortably as a pure manmade object in its context, enveloped by dramatic city views, and incorporates signature ARRCC design elements to create a modern and sophisticated presence while still ensuring that the personality of the home owner is reflected,” says Michele Rhoda. Mark Reilly, director of ARRCC added that “The interior spaces of the villa are kept relatively minimalistic, with bold textures and contrasting colour pallets adding richness to the spaces.”

title: Clifton Villa
summary: ARRCC Latest project in Cape Town, South Africa - Clifton Villa.

title: Victoria Residence
summary: Victoria residence is set in the Waterfall Country Estate, on a site overlooking the waterfall and a lush wetland.
story: The Residence stretches the width of the constrained site to maximize on becoming a receptacle for the views and expanse of nature to the north. The residence was conceived and developed as a monolithic stone remnant, which was sliced and excavated to reveal a softer and comforting interior. The exterior is rugged and purposefully reduced to two or three materials. In doing so, the transition to the interior enhances the crossover experience.

title: House Mosi
summary: House Mosi required the architects to create a single-storey home with an urban feel to substitute the 1950’s feel of the original design, converting it into a timeless modern house, with a layout suited to a contemporary lifestyle.
story: The architect created a plan with four bedrooms and large entertaining areas. Large double volume spaces and flat roofs were included in the additions and alterations to make vertical expansion easy for the home owner at a later stage. The house is divided into public and private spaces, the internal water feature and bridge is used as a natural division, while the entrance hall and a study are separated from the private home. Fulfilling the homeowner’s wish for an urban and open feel, the indoor and outdoor, and entertaining areas are blurred by frameless sliding stacking doors that open up the whole façade into a central atrium.

M Square Lifestyle Design created a harmonious balance between warm textured finishes and vast colour planes. The natural wood elements articulate texture and depth; which is essential to the welcoming ambience of the home. The correct styling enhances each room and brings the architectural design to a full and complete circle.

title: The Concrete House
summary: The concrete house, true Interior inspiration by Nico van der Meulen Architects

title: Kloof Road House
summary: Located at the foot of a nature reserve in Bedfordview, Johannesburg, you will find this family-orientated home suitable for indoor/outdoor entertainment that maximizes the views to the north. This is a 1,100 sqm (12,000 sqft) sculptural piece of architecture that is an extreme transformation from the previously modest single storey.
story: With every room in the house opening outdoors, linking the home with the landscaped garden, indoor/outdoor living is guaranteed. From the street, the boldly-designed off-shutter boundary wall with black steel shapes creeping over predicts that this is no ordinary piece of architecture.

Steel, glass, and concrete are prominently and have been integrated into the design, from the boundary wall all the way to the interior. The angled steel roof of the entrance hall overhangs the double volume window and glass front door at the entrance, while the sculptural steel staircase is visible behind the window.

M Square Lifestyle Design translated the architectural concept into the interior design. Steel perforated panels and off-shutter concrete were amongst the elements used for the interior, while the design of the lighting compliments the bold forms of the home and defines the angles. Concrete, glass, and steel visually link the interior and exterior, smoothly integrating architecture and interior design.

title: Stacked House, Sandton
summary: Discover a breathtaking new property in Sandton by renowned architect featuring a 1400sqm 3-storey residence on a 4100 sqm sloped site. The striking design boasts stacked and intersecting 'boxes' with monolithic concrete walls, clad in dark grey aluminum perforated screens and concrete panels.
story: This home features 5 bedrooms with en suite bathrooms, a home office, kids' study, formal and open-plan living, dining and kitchen areas that lead to a lanai and swimming pool. The basement includes a gym, entertainment room, wine cellar and home cinema. The property is fully equipped and automated, with PV panels, battery backup, and a generator for loadshedding.

Inside, enjoy natural tones with beautiful walnut timber flooring, Porcelanosa's Xtone Liem Grey tiles and metallic accents. The kitchen, scullery and pantry, and main bedroom wardrobes were supplied by M Square Lifestyle Necessities with appliances from Gaggenau. This unique and tailored property is perfect for immediate and extended family members and is truly a destination to behold.

title: House 03, Hyde Park
summary: The architecture is a bold mix of raw and slick materials, with dramatic volumes and lighting.

title: Oban House
summary: A smart equestrian house in Summerveld by Metropole Architects, designed around some of the best views on the KwaZulu-Natal north coast.

title: Villa de la Réserve
summary: The reserve house is a fusion of modern tropical architecture and a number of bold futuristic elements including a 4.3m high angled concrete wall that enters through the entrance hall, a column in concrete in the shape of a flared "T" that supports an imposing cantilevered upper story, and overhanging basins that project towards the ocean, all of which combine to evoke the impression of movement. The site offering a wide frontage on the ocean, the design was able to respond with an architecture in the form of outstretched wings that seem to float above the local vegetation of the dunes, thus taking full advantage of the panoramic views of the beach and the sea.

title: The YNE House
summary: The YNE House. Beautiful Completed House in Zimbali by Metropole Architects and Interior Design by Olala Interiors⠀

title: Umhlanga Forest House
summary: Umhlanga Forest House is a compact, 400 sqm, 3+Bedroom residence located Bloc architects in collaboration with Kevin Lloyd Architects.
story: The modern, tropical home features minimalist, raw concrete and steel volumes accented by wood cladding and shading. Open plan spaces bound by recessed floor-to-ceiling glass walls allow for a good amount natural light as well as views of the surrounding vista.

title: Umdloti Beach House 2
summary: Set high up one of of the last remaining greenfield sites in the idyllic seaside village of Umdloti, with sweeping 180 degree views up and down the coast.
story: This special piece of real estate won the 2020 African Property Awards in the single residential category. Designed by Bloc Architects

title: 9 Corkwood Drive
summary: Proud to present our very own 9 Corkwood Drive, Zimbali. Taking first place in South Africa with 5 Stars for International Property Awards.
story: This project was designed and built by Casa Design and @casaconstruction_za

title: Signature Residence, Sibaya
summary: Coming soon. New Residence in the exclusive Signature Estate, Sibaya.

title: House VG5
summary: The architects designing this home had one of the most exciting briefs. They were tasked to create a home for two lifelong friends and their respective families that catered to the individual briefs yet read as one cohesive residence.
story: This house explores the relationship between private and communal space. Two boxes are placed perpendicular to each other to create a wind free courtyard that also lets light into the house. The circulation for the two units is placed around the courtyard to encourage visibility and interaction between the two households yet allowing the private rooms to be screened from the communal zones.
Situated on a slopping site; the residence maintains a single storey height on the street side and cascades down the terrain opening itself up to the views of the mountain and sea beyond.
A play with materials is then used to make reference to the different levels of the house. A neutral colour palette has been used to allow the house to age gracefully with minimal maintenance.

title: Villa Victoria
summary: Villa Victoria with a sticking street appeal right on the coast line.

title: Sea Lion
summary: This property is a Luxury home with breathtaking views of the mountain and sea, designed to be a holiday rental at the very top end.

title: Fawcett’s Avenue
summary: “A challenge with this new build home was implementing a large & relatively complex brief into a small site. It comprises of two separate entrances and garages which access two completely private homes. It has been designed so that with the removal of just one wall, the duplex will function as a single residence with plenty of area for additional bedrooms and new unique spaces.”

title: House Thibault
summary: The brief was to design a spacious 740 square metre house, that is both contemporary and respects the context that includes some houses which date back to the 1700s. This resulted into a modern take on the classical Cape Dutch “H” house plan.
story: The house is divided into two zones, the more public living/entertainment areas are located on the ground floor and enjoy the ability to open out onto the garden area through full height sliding folding doors, while the more private areas are located on the first floor. The kitchen forms the heart of the house and was designed with the aim to bring the family together, to connect and to share meals on the kitchen bar counter while taking in the river view through the horizontal window. A notable feature of the house is the glass fronted wine cellar which is adjacent to the kitchen and close to the dining area.

The upstairs of the house comprises five en-suite bedrooms as well as a family pyjama lounge and his and hers studies. The ground and first level connect visually and spatially through the interlinking double volume spaces which furthermore encompass the floating steel and timber access staircase. The roof is light and “floating” to enable light to enter the house and to allow the tree-and mountainscape to be fully enjoyed. It is constructed of solid natural oak, which emphasises the connection to nature. Shading devices are used to extend and soften the roof edges whilst serving a functional need for shading.

title: House 280, Pearl Valley
summary: House 280, phenomenal design on Pearl Valleys signature golf course. Designed by Louis Phillips Architects .

title: Old Cape Home
summary: Old Cape Home ~ “Old Cape Home is positioned on a very steep West facing slope within the magnificent Simola Golf and Country Estate. Due to the steepness, the site boasts unparalleled drama and great views of the Knysna River.
story: Consequently we have sought a North orientation and superb views back to the golf course. This has been done by the placement of secondary bedrooms below the home, as a result the main living space above these rooms spills onto a huge covered deck. Planted roofs as a formal garden and a comfortable heated pool complete this large home, on a site that simply drops away.

The outdoor living space is designed in such a way that it is shields from the prevailing South Westerly winds. This is a welcome extension of the indoor living space. This is the ideal solution for this very social family.”

title: House Gouws
summary: The design had to take advantage of the beautiful surrounds, whilst providing privacy from public spaces. Solid southern- and western street boundaries with perforated aluminium screens provide privacy while allowing filtered natural light into the house.
story: A visual axis extends through the front door and entrance gallery and penetrates this privacy barrier. It links to a formal landscaped courtyard and the views beyond. A deck and seamless floor-to-ceiling sliding glass doors create the threshold between inside and out. The concept of seamless transition is carried through to detailing: the simplest possible transition between different building materials is utilised. Living and bedroom spaces are orientated inward around the internal courtyard.
Rhythmic progressing of proportions with honest expression of structure and materials help to orientate the user and make the architecture more intelligible.

title: Pitched-roof House, Southdowns
summary: Another stunning family home is situated in South Downs Estate, Centurion. The vernacular pitch roof architecture and materials are used in a sophisticated and contemporary approach to create a timeless elegance.
story: The roof pitch orientation and scale allow for an abundance of natural light from the North. The building is split to retain the traditional horizontal proportions of the neighbouring buildings while separating private from entertainment space with a central courtyard and connecting bridge element.

title: LKG Residence
summary: The client’s Brief on this project was Simple, straight forward and clear.
story: “CLIENT said: “Guys, Don’t give me a homey home. I’m young, all i want is an entertainment home.”
Well, being very generous with design, we Simply gave her both. Designed by Acute Innovation

title: Glass House, Serengeti
summary: Classic Elegance, at first glance this home is a home that comes style and a strong sense of masculinity. The design and layout of the house is one of transparency explains Paul Mtwa of Mtwa Architects .
story: Expansive glazing forms a soft shell around the house, bringing the exterior in and interior out. It’s east west axis invites the northern sunlight into all the living and private spaces. Once inside, the living and entertainment spaces lead into one another without any barriers, and this creates the foundation for a contemporary experience.

title: Contemporary Farmhouse, Waterfall
summary: The client had come across built work by Gottsmann Architects which he felt contextually appropriate to the proposed project. After listening to the client’s requests, Gottsmann Architects were tasked to design a contemporary farmhouse employing strong design elements and the use of various textures and vibrant materials.The property saw multiple members of the @skyfallconstruction SkyfallConstruction team work on the project and bring it to reality. From conception through to design development, detailing for construction and the delivery of such it required a great deal of design input and project role players to ensure the project is brought to completion.
story: The project features several unique features from the wooden screens and cladding to the minimalist water feature to name a few. Ultimately the design is a composition of curious and refined detailing, good flow, and open interactive spaces.

title: Rusted-steel House, Hazelwood
summary: Contemporary masterpiece underway the perfect home for entertaining. Immediately you’ll notice the unique facade mixed with wooden panels and rusted steel. The entire backyard opens up beautifully giving you that perfect indoor - Outdoor feel with the lounge, pool, spa and bar all nestled in perfectly.

title: Textured Facade, Sandton
summary: Beautiful mix of different textures & lines to create this timeless facade.

title: Indoor–Outdoor House, Bryanston
summary: This exceptional address has a beautiful Indoor outdoor space that flows seamlessly.

title: House 113
summary: This two-story house is the epitome of modern luxury. Situated in a lifestyle estate and in close proximity to schools and shopping malls creates the ultimate urban lifestyle for any family.
story: The open plan kitchen and living room area open onto the large patio and sparkling pool creating an amazing and inviting entertainment space.

The use of glass in the design creates unobstructed views of the pool and brings in natural light into the bedrooms which contributes to the pleasant ambience of the living and resting spaces. The bedrooms are all en-suite and the home has been completed with a blend of marble and timber textures giving it its timeless appeal.

title: Villa Meyersdal
summary: The design of this contemporary family home takes advantage of the temperate climate to allow seamless flow between spacious living spaces and beautiful landscaping of the exterior. Framed views of Johannesburg skyline and abundant natural light this home encourages a sense of welcome and relaxation.
story: Perfect proportions are elevated by elegant detailing from floor to ceiling and a particular attention to lighting design, creating a home which impresses every visitor and allows for a luxury and warm family living.

title: Warm Interior, Cotswold Downs
summary: Warm inviting space Novospace created in they last project at Cotswold downs golf estate.

title: Private Residence, Bronkhorstspruit Dam
summary: Feast your eyes on our latest proposed project for Private wealthy client - under construction now!
story: With a rooftop oasis featuring a private bar with a stunning glass and wood pergola, along with a variety of seating options perfect for guests and parties. Surrounding the area is a natural stone structure and lush greenery, creating a design-oriented space that feels like a private retreat. But that's not all – a jacuzzi pool, complete with water games and privacy-enhancing balustrades, or lounge on one of the sun tanning areas.

Inside the Master block of the property, you'll find a stunning master bedroom with a private balcony on the first floor, and an open-air relax room with a billiard table on the second floor. The ground floor features an outdoor dining area for guests, along with a cocktail bar located outside the living room. And don't forget about the pool bar, accessible from both inside and outside the infinity pool.

title: AURUM Presidential Residences
summary: Expansive, exemplary and bathed in natural light, AURUM's eight Presidential Residences are beyond compare. Each residence will occupy its own floor and enjoy private lift access.
story: True opulence in this case is the view - and it is capitalised on at every opportunity, with extensive floor to ceiling glazing, vast open-plan living spaces and a complementary colour palette of soft neutral tones.

In addition to Armani Dada designer kitchens, each residence will boast imported appliances, dressing room fittings, sanitary ware and sound systems from famous international designers - a standard of finish that raises the bar in both a local and international context.

Ultra spacious bedroom and living room layouts Designer kitchens from the Armani Dada Collection (in the three penthouse residences) with @gaggenauofficial integrated appliances Dressing room by Italian fitters Molteni and C Dada - Audio visual systems by sound masters @bangolufsen Sanitary ware fitting by Italian craftsmen @gessi_official

title: Botanica at Hohenort
summary: Botanica at Hohenort - Secure residential estate in Constantia, Western Cape.
story: A truly exclusive boutique estate, located opposite the Hohenort Hotel in the Constantia Valley, there is little in the area that comes close in comparison. Designed to embrace its lush surroundings, each of the four residences is at home with nature – a place of privacy, security and solitude. A place that enhances your relationship with the outdoors.

Implementing the best European trends and qualities, the iconic architecture is the heart of this estate. Each home fuses contemporary design with functionality. Featuring top of the range security and easy-living technologies, each home is fully automated, allowing you to control everything from security, air-conditioning and lighting right through to music and movies. We call it living smart – letting you focus on the things that matter. Botanica is about seamless transitions. Residents will enjoy the bountiful luxury Botanica offers and truly appreciate the advanced technologies that take each home to new levels of sustainability. Continuing the environmental focus, features such as rain water harvesting, water wise gardens, integrated water heating systems with solar supplementation and grey and black water recycling have been introduced.

title: Signature House, Waterfall
summary: Another Signature contemporary home built by @zotos_construction in Waterfall Country Estate.
